# Binary
```{r}
result1 = read.csv("sim_results_binary.csv")
head(result1)
```

## Together
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)  # install.packages("patchwork") if needed

## --- 0) Keep only selected dissimilarities ---
keep_diss <- c("UniFrac", "weighted UniFrac", "Bray-Curtis", "Jaccard", "GLaD")

result1_sub <- result1 %>%
  filter(dissimilarity %in% keep_diss) %>%
  mutate(dissimilarity = factor(dissimilarity, levels = keep_diss))

## --- 1) Long form summary (one row per dissimilarity × Delta × method) ---
by_delta_long <- result1_sub %>%
  select(dissimilarity, Delta, p_unadj, p_pool, p_ipw) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(p_unadj, p_pool, p_ipw),
               names_to = "method", values_to = "p") %>%
  group_by(dissimilarity, Delta, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(p)),
    prop_sig = mean(p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(dissimilarity, Delta, method)

## --- 2) Method labels for plotting ---
method_labels <- c(
  p_unadj = "adonis2 (unadjusted)",
  p_pool  = "adonis2 (+ Z)",
  p_ipw   = "IPW-PERMANOVA"
)

plot_df <- by_delta_long %>%
  mutate(
    method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("adonis2 (unadjusted)",
                                       "adonis2 (+ Z)",
                                       "IPW-PERMANOVA"))
  )

## --- 3) Fewer x-axis labels to avoid overlap ---
delta_breaks <- pretty(range(plot_df$Delta, na.rm = TRUE), n = 4)

## --- 4) Build one plot per dissimilarity; y-axis title only on the first; no legend ---
diss_levels <- levels(plot_df$dissimilarity)

plot_list <- lapply(seq_along(diss_levels), function(i) {
  diss <- diss_levels[i]
  df_i <- plot_df %>% filter(dissimilarity == diss)

  p <- ggplot(df_i, aes(x = Delta, y = prop_sig,
                        color = method, linetype = method, shape = method)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = delta_breaks) +
    labs(
      x = expression(Delta),
      y = if (i == 1) "Proportion with p < 0.05" else NULL,
      title = diss
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10)
    )

  if (i != 1) {
    p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
  }
  p
})

combined_1x5 <-
  wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 1) 

print(combined_1x5)

```

## With different setting
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)  # install.packages("patchwork") if needed

## --- 0) Choose dissimilarities to plot (and keep a nice order) ---
keep_diss <- c("UniFrac", "weighted UniFrac", "Bray-Curtis", "Jaccard")

result1_sub <- result1 %>%
  filter(dissimilarity %in% keep_diss) %>%
  mutate(dissimilarity = factor(dissimilarity, levels = keep_diss))

## --- 1) Summarize p<0.05 by dissimilarity × Delta × method × n × ps ---
by_panel <- result1_sub %>%
  select(dissimilarity, n, ps, Delta, p_unadj, p_pool, p_ipw) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(p_unadj, p_pool, p_ipw), names_to = "method", values_to = "p") %>%
  group_by(dissimilarity, n, ps, Delta, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tests  = sum(!is.na(p)),
    prop_sig = mean(p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

## --- 2) Nice labels / factors ---
method_labels <- c(
  p_unadj = "adonis2 (unadjusted)",
  p_pool  = "adonis2 (+ Z)",
  p_ipw   = "IPW-PERMANOVA"
)

plot_df <- by_panel %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(recode(method, !!!method_labels),
                    levels = c("adonis2 (unadjusted)", "adonis2 (+ Z)", "IPW-PERMANOVA")),
    n_f  = factor(n,  levels = c(40, 60, 80), labels = c("n = 40", "n = 60", "n = 80")),
    ps_f = factor(ps, levels = c(0.2, 2.0),   labels = c("Weak", "Strong"))
  )

## --- 3) Fewer axis labels (avoid overlap) ---
delta_breaks <- scales::pretty_breaks(n = 4)(plot_df$Delta)
y_breaks     <- c(0, 0.5, 1)  # fewer y-axis numbers

## --- 4) One faceted plot per dissimilarity, then stack vertically (5 × 1) ---
diss_levels <- levels(plot_df$dissimilarity)

plot_list <- lapply(seq_along(diss_levels), function(i) {
  diss <- diss_levels[i]
  df_i <- plot_df %>% filter(dissimilarity == diss)

  ggplot(df_i, aes(x = Delta, y = prop_sig,
                   color = method, linetype = method, shape = method)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = y_breaks,
      labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = delta_breaks) +
    facet_grid(ps_f ~ n_f) +
    labs(
      title = diss,
      x = if (i == length(diss_levels)) expression(Delta) else NULL,
      y = if (i == 3) "Proportion with p < 0.05" else NULL   # y-label only on 3rd plot
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.spacing.y = unit(0.9, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title  = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text  = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6))
    )
})

combined_5x1_1 <-
  wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 1) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Proportion of significant tests by Δ",
    subtitle = "Faceted by sample size (columns) and confounding strength ps (rows); one panel per dissimilarity"
  )

print(combined_5x1_1)

```

## Together
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Long form summary (one row per Delta × method)
by_delta_long <- result %>%
  select(Delta, p_unadj, p_pool, p_ipw) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Delta, names_to = "method", values_to = "p") %>%
  group_by(Delta, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(p)),
    prop_sig = mean(p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Delta, method)

by_delta_long

library(ggplot2)

# Map method names for plotting
method_labels <- c(
  p_unadj = "adonis2 (unadjusted)",
  p_pool  = "adonis2 (+ Z)",
  p_ipw   = "IPW-PERMANOVA"
)

plot_df <- by_delta_long %>%
  mutate(method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
         method = factor(method, levels = c("adonis2 (unadjusted)",
                                            "adonis2 (+ Z)",
                                            "IPW-PERMANOVA")))

gg <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Delta, y = prop_sig,
                          color = method, linetype = method, shape = method)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(plot_df$Delta))) +
  labs(x = expression(Delta),
       y = "Proportion with p < 0.05",
       color = "Method", linetype = "Method", shape = "Method",
       title = "Proportion of significant tests by Δ",
       subtitle = "Aggregated over replicates / dissimilarities") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(gg)
```

# Combine

```{r}
library(patchwork)

# Clean each block (remove its own title/subtitle; no legends)
clean_block <- function(p) {
  p + plot_annotation(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) &
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# Wrap each block so patchwork treats it as ONE "leaf" plot
b1 <- wrap_elements(full = clean_block(combined_5x1_1))
b2 <- wrap_elements(full = clean_block(combined_5x1_2))
b3 <- wrap_elements(full = clean_block(combined_5x1_3))

# Now stacking will tag only the 3 blocks: a, b, c
combined_all <-
  (b1 / b2 / b3) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(
    plot.tag.position = c(0, 1),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(combined_all)
ggsave("SimulatedResult.png", combined_all, width = 8, height = 17, dpi = 1000)
```


```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

# Remove internal titles/subtitles from each combined_5x1 block
strip_block <- function(p) {
  p + plot_annotation(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)
}

# ---- Blocks (remove y-axis TITLE from both; keep y-axis ticks/labels) ----
p1 <- strip_block(combined_5x1_1) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_blank()   # remove internal y label
  )

# Put legend at bottom temporarily so we can extract it; center it
p2_with_leg <- strip_block(combined_5x1_2) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.justification = "center",
    axis.title.y = element_blank()   # remove internal y label in the 2nd column too
  )

# Extract legend ONCE (method legend with color/linetype/shape)
leg_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(p2_with_leg)
leg_plot <- cowplot::ggdraw(leg_grob)

# Remove legend from p2 for the top panel (since legend will be shared at bottom)
p2 <- strip_block(combined_5x1_2) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_blank()   # remove internal y label
  )

# Wrap blocks so patchwork tags ONLY these two blocks (not inner dissimilarities)
b1 <- wrap_elements(full = p1)
b2 <- wrap_elements(full = p2)

# ---- Combine two columns + ONLY a/b tags ----
top_row <-
  (b1 | b2) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(
    plot.tag.position = c(0, 1),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# ---- Add shared legend at bottom ----
combined_base <-
  top_row /
  wrap_elements(full = leg_plot) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.05))  # adjust 0.05 if you want more/less legend height

# ---- Add ONE shared y-axis label, vertically centered ----
# Give the whole plot some extra left margin so the label doesn't overlap
combined_base <- combined_base & theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 40))

combined_binary_continuous <-
  cowplot::ggdraw(combined_base) +
  cowplot::draw_label(
    "Proportion with p < 0.05",
    x = 0.03, y = 0.55, angle = 90,
    vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5
  )

print(combined_binary_continuous)

ggsave(
  "SimulatedResult_BinaryContinous.png",
  combined_binary_continuous,
  width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 1000
)


# ---- Ordinal saved separately (its own legend, centered) ----
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

strip_block <- function(p) {
  p + plot_annotation(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)
}

# ---- Ordinal: remove internal y-axis title, add ONE centered y-axis label, keep legend bottom ----
ordinal_base <- strip_block(combined_5x1_3) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.justification = "center",
    axis.title.y = element_blank()            # remove internal y label
  )

# Give extra left margin so the shared label won't overlap
ordinal_base <- ordinal_base & theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 40))

ordinal_plot <-
  cowplot::ggdraw(ordinal_base) +
  cowplot::draw_label(
    "Proportion with p < 0.05",
    x = 0.1, y = 0.55, angle = 90,
    vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5
  )

print(ordinal_plot)

ggsave(
  "SimulatedResult_Ordinal.png",
  ordinal_plot,
  width = 8, height = 9, dpi = 1000
)



```
